description: This file defines the GatewayConnectConfig structure which encapsulates the configuration parameters for connecting to a gateway within an iOS app. It includes properties such as URL, tokens, TLS parameters, and connection options, along with a method to compute an effective stable ID used for persistence keys.

methods.name: effectiveStableID
methods.description: Computes a sanitized, non-empty identifier for gateway-scoped persistence that defaults to the URL string if the provided stableID is empty or whitespace.
